description: Computes burn rate, percent expended, and NCE (no-cost extension) risk per award from transaction-level sponsored program data. Groups transactions by award ID, calculates cumulative spend against budget, and flags awards nearing or exceeding the NCE threshold. Optionally produces PI-level productivity summaries and K-Means award clusters by research area. Each input row is returned with award-level metrics merged in.

budget_column.description: Column containing the award budget (constant per award, or sliced per transaction)

award_id_column.description: Column containing the award or grant ID

pi_column.description: Principal investigator name column (optional; enables PI-level rollup in diagnostics)

research_area_column.description: Research area or department column (optional; enables K-Means clustering by area)

nce_threshold.description: Burn-rate fraction above which nce_risk is flagged true (default 0.90 = 90% expended)

n_clusters.description: Number of K-Means clusters when research_area_column is supplied
